verdict.rationale: Devin's docs say it can build and test iOS/macOS applications on its own VMs, and that with Auto-Fix it iterates on CI failures, which shows some self-validation through running tests. Nothing shows Devin writing new tests for its changes or running them before proposing, and CI iteration happens after a PR exists. missing for 10: documented automatic test generation, explicit pre-proposal test-run validation loop, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent automatically generate and run tests to validate its own code changes before proposing them
